posts.en:
dsh-web-artifact-designer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-0e16b0406042a1c3734d.html
